WITH sales_summary AS (
  SELECT
    sales_channel,
    fulfilment_channel AS courier,
    'Increff WMS' AS oms_system,
    COUNT(DISTINCT document_id) AS total_sales_orders
  FROM zs_observe.increff_sales
  WHERE group_level_id = 22
    AND sales_channel IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
),
returns_summary AS (
  SELECT
    sales_channel,
    COUNT(DISTINCT return_order_id) AS total_returned_orders,
    MAX(return_order_type) AS primary_return_model
  FROM zs_observe.increff_returns
  WHERE group_level_id = 22
    AND sales_channel IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
  s.sales_channel,
  s.oms_system,
  s.courier,
  s.total_sales_orders,
  COALESCE(r.total_returned_orders, 0) AS total_returned_orders,
  COALESCE(r.primary_return_model, 'N/A') AS return_ownership_model
FROM sales_summary s
LEFT JOIN returns_summary r
  ON s.sales_channel = r.sales_channel
ORDER BY s.total_sales_orders DESC, total_returned_orders DESC;
